test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 3 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Six persons M1, M2, M3, M4, M5 and M6 are sitting in a row facing towards north (not necessarily in the same order). Only three persons sit between M2 and M3. M3 is sitting to the immediate left of M5. Only three person sit between M1 and M5. M4 sits to the immediate left of M6 and is to the right of M3.

How many persons are sitting between M3 and M6?
solution:
From the given information:

Step 1: Only three persons sit between M2 and M3. M3 is sitting to the immediate left of M5. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4da221049b996f3697aaeb6d0095d2d218d70dc4e3627593e4461a6fe860513e.png] 

Step 2: Only three persons sit between M1 and M5.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5abbddda848e183edc6fd162dec6bfc55d9db889eb5f00d93dca273613cbd908.png] 

Step 3: M4 sits to the immediate left of M6 and is to the right of M3.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f2cea3a2f2c6525efc98fc2234e60750d6528938bd887c039b3dc08da8381298.png] 

From the diagram we can see, **there are two people between M3 and M6.**

Hence, **the correct answer is option 4).**
